issues.issue: Whether the 2009 abduction and confinement were due to the claimant's sexual orientation (section 96)
issues.applicant_position: Abductors knew her name, so they were sent by her partner's father because she is a lesbian.
issues.result_text: Claimant has not shown on a balance of probabilities that the 2009 incident happened because of her sexual orientation.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces risk in Mexico or Mexico City, including settling there
issues.applicant_position: Claimant does not want to return to Mexico, fearing discrimination due to sexual orientation, though Mexico City is possible.
issues.result_text: No evidence of risk in Mexico or Mexico City under sections 96 or 97(1); settling there is not unreasonable.

issues.issue: Whether past discrimination amounts to persecution or an intolerable life
issues.applicant_position: Claimant alleges lifelong discrimination due to sexual orientation, including incidents with her father, school, jobs and neighbours.
issues.result_text: Discrimination incidents are not significant enough to establish a reasonable fear of persecution or intolerable life.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant has shown a risk to life, cruel treatment or torture under section 97
issues.applicant_position: Claimant alleges risk of cruel treatment or torture if returned to Mexico.
issues.result_text: Claimant has not discharged the burden of showing a serious possibility of persecution or section 97 risk.
